decision: An item is GO when (a) its R2 at b = 0.5 is at least 0.05 points below ref's R2 at b = 0.5, (b) its 4-seed standalone October non-LIRF RMSE is below ref's, and (c) the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval (tools/nn_design_report.day_interval, October days) of the proxy RMSE difference between the item's and ref's tables at b = 0.5 lies below zero. Otherwise NO-GO. GO items go to a development round declared separately (hardware named) against the incumbent with the unchanged development rule; if two or more items are GO, a separately declared GPU combination batch on this fold precedes it.
note: October only; no scoring month read.
